result.note: Official monthly trade data release; tested the direction of exports, gold imports and the deficit excluding petroleum and gems and jewellery.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about India's merchandise trade data for August 2026, released by the Commerce Ministry in September 2026:
items: Goods exports rose by more than 25% compared with August 2025.
Gold imports fell compared with August 2025.
Excluding petroleum and gems and jewellery, the trade deficit narrowed compared with August 2025.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: Exports rose 26.1% and gold imports fell 57.75% year on year, but the deficit excluding petroleum and gems and jewellery widened to USD 14.54 billion from USD 13.13 billion, because imports grew from a larger base. The overall deficit of USD 26.86 billion narrowed by just USD 360 million year on year.
questions.source: Imports started from a larger base, so the deficit in those goods widened to USD 14.54 billion, from USD 13.13 billion a year earlier.
